key.name: toggle-pin
key.description: Keybinding to pin/unpin the currently focused window to all workspaces.

key.name: panel-box
key.description: Which area of the top panel hosts the pin icon.

key.name: panel-index
key.description: Position of the indicator inside the chosen panel box (0 = first).

key.name: pin-opacity
key.description: Window opacity applied while pinned. 255 = fully opaque, lower values make pinned windows see-through.
